stat.guildmark.vigor.desc: Toughness of body. Every point adds to your max health.
stat.guildmark.focus.desc: The well weapon skills, sorceries and prayers draw from. Every point deepens it.
stat.guildmark.endurance.desc: Stamina, how quickly it comes back, and how much armour you can wear before your rolls turn heavy.
stat.guildmark.might.desc: Raw strength: poise to stay on your feet and a stand that blows can't shift. Heavy weapons follow it most.
stat.guildmark.finesse.desc: Quick hands and light feet: a faster tempo and softer falls. Swords, spears and bows follow it.
stat.guildmark.arcana.desc: Learning in the old arts. Sorceries ask for it and hit harder with it; focus comes back faster, weapon skills hit harder and magic hurts you less.
stat.guildmark.faith.desc: Trust in the Wardens' fire. Prayers ask for it and grow stronger with it; the flask heals more, the dead fear your blows and flame burns you less.
skill.guildmark.blades.desc: Swords, daggers, sabres and spears. Grows with every blow and kill made with one.
skill.guildmark.heavy_arms.desc: Greatswords, axes, hammers and tridents. Grows with every blow and kill made with one, thrown tridents too.
skill.guildmark.archery.desc: Bows and crossbows. Grows with every arrow that finds its mark.
skill.guildmark.guarding.desc: Blocking and parrying. Grows with every blow you turn aside.
skill.guildmark.evasion.desc: Rolling out of harm's way. Grows as you roll in a fight, most of all through a blow.
skill.guildmark.armor.desc: Wearing armour well. Grows with the damage your armour takes for you.
skill.guildmark.stealth.desc: Going unseen. Grows as you sneak near monsters that haven't noticed you, and with blows that catch them unaware.
skill.guildmark.smithing.desc: Making and mending gear. Grows as you craft tools, weapons and armour, smelt ingots and repair at an anvil.
skill.guildmark.alchemy.desc: Grows with every potion you brew.
skill.guildmark.cooking.desc: Grows as you cook in a furnace or smoker and make meals at the crafting table.
skill.guildmark.enchanting.desc: Grows as you enchant gear and bind enchanted books at an anvil.
skill.guildmark.mining.desc: Grows as you dig stone and ore with a pickaxe; the rarer the ore, the more.
skill.guildmark.woodcutting.desc: Grows as you fell trees in the wild.
skill.guildmark.farming.desc: Grows as you harvest ripe crops, and breed and tame animals.
skill.guildmark.trade.desc: Grows as you trade with villagers and turn in contracts.
skill.guildmark.sorcery.desc: Casting sorceries with a staff. Grows with every sorcery cast, and more with every foe it strikes.
skill.guildmark.prayer.desc: Saying prayers over a censer. Grows with every prayer said, every foe it burns and every wound it closes.

tree.guildmark.root.desc: Where every path begins. Four roads lead out to the ring, and the ring to every branch.
tree.guildmark.gate.sword.desc: The road out to the fighting arts.
tree.guildmark.gate.hand.desc: The road out to the crafts.
tree.guildmark.gate.coin.desc: The road out to trade and the guild.
tree.guildmark.gate.wilds.desc: The road out to the wild trades.
tree.guildmark.blades.duelist.desc: Meet the blade, then answer it.
tree.guildmark.blades.flowing_steel.desc: Each cut is the start of the next.
tree.guildmark.blades.crimson_edge.desc: The edge drinks what it spills.
tree.guildmark.blades.steel_tempest.desc: Your weapon arts come easier and land harder.
tree.guildmark.blades.blade_dancer.desc: A dancer never plants their feet, and neither do you.
tree.guildmark.heavy_arms.brute_force.de: Wind up, and let the weight do the rest.
tree.guildmark.heavy_arms.warlord.desc: Seasoned in the press of battle.
tree.guildmark.heavy_arms.juggernaut.des: Slow to start and slower to stop. Not even death stops you, once between rests.
tree.guildmark.guarding.steadfast.desc: Hold the line, and hold it long.
tree.guildmark.guarding.keen_parry.desc: You see the blow before it falls.
tree.guildmark.guarding.retaliation.desc: Every blow turned aside is owed back.
tree.guildmark.guarding.bulwark.desc: Behind the shield you rest as if beside a fire.
tree.guildmark.armor.well_fitted.desc: Plate worn as easily as leather.
tree.guildmark.armor.iron_skin.desc: Your hide turns what your armour misses.
tree.guildmark.armor.warded.desc: Old charms against fire, blast and spell.
tree.guildmark.armor.iron_fortress.desc: A walking keep: hard to wound and harder to move.
tree.guildmark.stealth.ambusher.desc: Strike before they know you're there.
tree.guildmark.stealth.unseen.desc: The first anyone knows of you is the blow.
tree.guildmark.stealth.shadow.desc: You live between their glances, and pay in blood when seen.
tree.guildmark.archery.quick_draw.desc: The string is drawn before the thought is done.
tree.guildmark.archery.hunters_eye.desc: Beasts fall to the first arrow.
tree.guildmark.archery.eagle_eye.desc: Find the gap in any armour, even a giant's.
tree.guildmark.archery.deadeye.desc: Every arrow true. Up close, you fumble.
tree.guildmark.evasion.light_feet.desc: Quick on your feet, soft when you land.
tree.guildmark.evasion.ghost_step.desc: For a breath you are not there at all.
tree.guildmark.evasion.slipstream.desc: Slip a blow and the wind fills your lungs.
tree.guildmark.evasion.acrobat.desc: Ledges, leaps and falls hold no fear.
tree.guildmark.evasion.wraith_step.desc: Half here, half elsewhere, and frail in both.
tree.guildmark.sorcery.spellweaver.desc: Your hands know the shapes before your mind does.
tree.guildmark.sorcery.deep_reserves.des: A well that runs deeper than it looks.
tree.guildmark.sorcery.starseer.desc: You read the old patterns, and strike where they point.
tree.guildmark.sorcery.still_mind.desc: Calm enough to turn spells aside, and to hold one more of your own.
tree.guildmark.sorcery.archmage.desc: All of you given to the art, and the body pays for it.
tree.guildmark.prayer.devout.desc: Prayers said every morning, and one more remembered.
tree.guildmark.prayer.mercy.desc: The flame that burns the dead warms the living.
tree.guildmark.prayer.bane_of_the_hollow: The Hollow shrink from what you carry.
tree.guildmark.prayer.zealot.desc: Quick to pray, and quicker to burn.
tree.guildmark.prayer.lightbearer.desc: A lamp in the dark, seen from far off by friend and foe alike.
tree.guildmark.smithing.hot_bellows.desc: A hotter fire wrings more from the ore.
tree.guildmark.smithing.tempered.desc: Steel quenched just so outlasts its maker.
tree.guildmark.smithing.thrifty_smith.de: Mend more and pay less for it.
tree.guildmark.smithing.armsmaster.desc: You know every blade and plate you've forged.
tree.guildmark.smithing.master_artisan.d: Your work will be handed down for generations.
tree.guildmark.enchanting.frugal_scholar: The words cost you less to speak.
tree.guildmark.enchanting.runic_ward.des: Runes worked into your skin turn spells aside.
You drink the light from every spark of knowing.
tree.guildmark.alchemy.physician.desc: A healer's touch, even on yourself.
tree.guildmark.alchemy.purity.desc: What poisons others barely troubles you.
tree.guildmark.alchemy.philosopher.desc: The great work, nearly done: another draught in the Warden's Flask.
tree.guildmark.cooking.hearty_meals.desc: Food that sticks to your ribs.
tree.guildmark.cooking.second_helping.de: There's always a little more in the pot.
tree.guildmark.cooking.comfort_food.desc: A good meal mends more than hunger.
tree.guildmark.cooking.camp_cook.desc: Fed well on the road, you rest well too.
tree.guildmark.cooking.feast_maker.desc: Your table is spoken of in every inn.
tree.guildmark.trade.shrewd_bargainer.de: Now and then you talk the price down to nothing.
tree.guildmark.trade.well_connected.desc: A word here and a favour there buys time.
tree.guildmark.trade.merchant_prince.des: Coin and goodwill follow you like a shadow.
tree.guildmark.guild.haggler.desc: The guild pays what you ask.
tree.guildmark.guild.veteran.desc: You have seen it all, and lived.
tree.guildmark.guild.guild_champion.desc: The guild's finest, and the guild knows it.
tree.guildmark.farming.green_thumb.desc: Your fields always yield a little more.
tree.guildmark.farming.harvest_home.desc: The best of the harvest is yours.
tree.guildmark.farming.ploughman.desc: The soil turns easily, and the walk home is short.
tree.guildmark.farming.green_hand.desc: What you reap sows itself again.
tree.guildmark.fishing.patient_angler.de: Good things come to those who wait.
tree.guildmark.fishing.treasure_hunter.d: The deep gives up its secrets.
tree.guildmark.fishing.seas_favour.desc: The sea itself fills your nets.
tree.guildmark.woodcutting.woodsmans_sha: Every tree gives a little more.
tree.guildmark.woodcutting.forest_stride: Roots and brush don't slow you.
tree.guildmark.woodcutting.woodsmans_axe: The arm that fells an oak can fell a foe.
tree.guildmark.woodcutting.timberfall.de: One cut, and the whole tree comes down.
tree.guildmark.mining.prospector.desc: You know where the richest seams run.
tree.guildmark.mining.deep_delver.desc: At home in the deep places: blasts, floods and stale air.
tree.guildmark.mining.lucky_strike.desc: Sometimes the rock gives up more than it should.
tree.guildmark.mining.vein_breaker.desc: Strike one ore, and the whole vein follows.

lore.guildmark.0.title: Lore: The First Charter
lore.guildmark.0.page0: Before the walls and before the roads, every village stood alone. Then seven elders met at a cold bell and signed the First Charter, and the Old Guild was born.
lore.guildmark.0.page1: The Charter asked only this: that any villager in need could pin a note, and any stranger with a blade could answer it. The boards you see today are its children.
lore.guildmark.1.title: Lore: Wardens of the Road
lore.guildmark.1.page0: The Old Guild's best were called Wardens. They walked the roads between villages and kept them clear of beasts, and no caravan went unguarded.
lore.guildmark.1.page1: A Warden wore no crown and took no village as their own. 'The road is the only home we keep,' says the oath. Few remember the rest of it.
lore.guildmark.2.title: Lore: The Hollow King
lore.guildmark.2.page0: One Warden feared death more than any beast. He carved out his own heart and set a crown where it had been, and he did not die. They call him the Hollow King.
lore.guildmark.2.page1: Without a heart he could not be wounded, and without a heart he could not love the villages he swore to guard. He turned the beasts of the wild into his court.
lore.guildmark.3.title: Lore: The Court of Beasts
lore.guildmark.3.page0: The Broodmother, the Barrow Lord, the Drowned Herald, the Hollow Crone, the Frost Regent and the Ash Warden: these were his courtiers, each given a shard of his hollow crown and a den to rule.
lore.guildmark.3.page1: The lairs you clear are what is left of that court. Their masters still remember the crown, and some say they still answer when it calls.
lore.guildmark.4.title: Lore: The Sundering
lore.guildmark.4.page0: When the Wardens marched on the Hollow King, the battle split the land itself. The Old Guild won, but there were not enough Wardens left to keep the roads.
lore.guildmark.4.page1: Roads became grass. Villages forgot each other. Only the boards and the coins survived, and the coins were melted and stamped again as Guild Marks.
lore.guildmark.5.title: Lore: The Ledger of Names
lore.guildmark.5.page0: Every guild hall keeps a copy of the Ledger of Names: each adventurer who ever passed a trial, from F to S. The receptionists guard it closely.
lore.guildmark.5.page1: The oldest pages hold only Warden names, and the last of them is torn out. Receptionists will not say who tore it, or why.
lore.guildmark.6.title: Lore: The Seven Shards
lore.guildmark.6.page0: The Hollow King's crown did not melt. It broke into seven shards, and the shards were hidden where no one would look: in the dens of his own court.
lore.guildmark.6.page1: While the shards are apart, the King cannot wake. If they were ever brought together, he would rise wherever they met.
lore.guildmark.7.title: Lore: The Last Warden
lore.guildmark.7.page0: The last Warden was named Maren. She carried the torn page of the Ledger away from the final battle, and walked off the end of every map.
lore.guildmark.7.page1: Old travellers swear they have met her on the roads at dusk, asking each adventurer the same question: 'What rank are you, and is it enough?'

character.guildmark.wren.intro: Oh! You're the one with the guild contracts, aren't you? Wren Ashdown, cartographer. Well, I will be, once I finish a map anyone believes.
character.guildmark.wren.step0: I'm charting where the Old Guild hid things. Problem is, I've drawn so many maps I've run out of paper. Bring me twelve sheets and I'll tell you what I'm really after.
character.guildmark.wren.step1: Right, the secret: the Hollow King's crown broke into seven shards, and I think one is buried in a spider den near here. The spiders keep eating my survey stakes, though. Thin them out?
character.guildmark.wren.step1.note: "They ate my compass too. The whole compass."
character.guildmark.wren.step2: Found the den. It goes deep, and something big lives at the bottom. You go first. I'll take notes. Very brave notes.
character.guildmark.wren.step2.note: "If you find a shiny bit of crown, do not lick it."
character.guildmark.wren.waiting: Still at it? Take your time. Actually, don't. I'm terribly impatient.
character.guildmark.wren.finale: You found it! A real shard of the crown. Seven of these together and the Hollow King wakes, so let's never put them together, yes? Keep it. You'll mind it better than I would.
character.guildmark.wren.done: Six shards left out there. I'm marking every rumour on my map. When you're ready, the world will be waiting.
character.guildmark.wren.gift: First Shard of the Hollow Crown
character.guildmark.wren.gift.lore: Cold to the touch. It hums near lairs.
character.guildmark.wren.topic.maps.0: Every map I've ever sold was wrong. Not my fault! The villages stay put, but the roads wander off, and a map is mostly roads.
character.guildmark.wren.topic.maps.1: The Old Guild had perfect maps, apparently. Nobody's seen one in three hundred years. So I'm drawing my own, and mine will be better, because mine will have notes in the margins.
character.guildmark.wren.topic.king: What do you know about the Hollow King?
character.guildmark.wren.topic.king.0: Everyone knows the song. A Warden so afraid of dying that he carved out his own heart and set a crown in its place. Lovely bedtime story.
character.guildmark.wren.topic.king.1: The trouble is, the song stops too early. Something happened to that crown after they beat him, and nobody ever wrote down what. I have a theory. I always have a theory.
character.guildmark.tobin.epithet: The Old Sword, last squire of the Wardens
character.guildmark.tobin.intro: Hmph. Another badge-polisher. Name's Tobin. I carried a Warden's shield before your grandmother was born, and I've watched every guild since go soft.
character.guildmark.tobin.step0: Prove you're not soft. The dead are walking the old charter road again. Put down a dozen of them and we'll talk.
character.guildmark.tobin.step0.note: "Aim for the head. They don't need it, but it slows them down."
character.guildmark.tobin.step1: Not bad. I mean to forge a Warden's blade one last time, but my forge is cold and my stock is empty. Sixteen iron ingots. Good ones.
character.guildmark.tobin.step1.note: "Not the rusty stuff from shipwrecks. I'll know."
character.guildmark.tobin.step2: The blade's ready, but it needs a purpose. There's a barrow where my old master was laid to rest, and something wearing his armour rules it now. Lay him to rest properly.
character.guildmark.tobin.step2.note: "Tell him Tobin sent you. He won't listen. Hit him anyway."
character.guildmark.tobin.waiting: Standing around won't get it done. Off with you.
character.guildmark.tobin.finale: So it's done. He can rest. Here, a Warden's blade is no use hanging on my wall. The oath goes: 'The road is the only home we keep.' Don't make me regret it.
character.guildmark.tobin.done: The road is long, adventurer. Keep it clear.
character.guildmark.tobin.gift.lore: "The road is the only home we keep."
The best of the Old Guild. No village to call home, no crown, no coin worth counting. We walked the roads between the bells and kept the beasts off the carts.
That's all it was. That was everything. When the Wardens went, the roads went with them. Look around you.
One, maybe. Halvard. Best sword I ever carried a shield for. When the King fell, Halvard stayed at his post, and they tell me he's standing there still.
Dead men don't keep oaths. Something else is keeping his for him. If you ever meet him, don't stop to listen. Hit him, and keep hitting him. It's the only kindness left.
character.guildmark.ilsa.epithet: Cleric of the Quiet Bell, scholar of the Hollow King
character.guildmark.ilsa.intro: Ah, forgive me, I didn't hear you come in. I'm Ilsa. I study the things most clerics pray never to hear of. Chiefly, the Hollow King.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step0: The skeletons around here have started humming, all on the same note. Bring down ten of them and I'll listen to what's left.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step0.note: "Please don't step on the skulls. I need those."
character.guildmark.ilsa.step1: It's a summons. Something is calling the old court back together. Amethyst holds a sound for a long time, so with eight shards I can catch the echo and learn where it comes from.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step1.note: "Clear ones, if you can. Cloudy amethyst only remembers rumours."
character.guildmark.ilsa.step2: The echo leads to a hollow where a crone keeps the King's old rites. She was one of his courtiers. If she falls, the call goes quiet. For now.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step2.note: "Do not answer if she speaks your name."
character.guildmark.ilsa.waiting: The bones are still humming. Please hurry, if you can.
character.guildmark.ilsa.finale: The humming has stopped. Thank you. I've copied out what I learned about the King and his court, and you should have it. And take this. I'd feel better knowing you carry it.
character.guildmark.ilsa.done: The court is quiet, but quiet is not gone. I'll keep listening.
character.guildmark.ilsa.gift.lore: A totem wrapped in a cleric's prayer ribbon.
character.guildmark.ilsa.topic.bell.0: My order rings a bell that makes no sound. Please don't laugh. A bell can be heard without being loud, if you know how to listen.
character.guildmark.ilsa.topic.bell.1: The dead have very good ears. When we ring it, the restless ones lie down again. Usually. The Hollow King's court has never once listened.
character.guildmark.ilsa.topic.court: Tell me about the King's court.
character.guildmark.ilsa.topic.court.0: Six courtiers, each given a den to rule: the Broodmother, the Barrow Lord, the Drowned Herald, the Hollow Crone, the Frost Regent and the Ash Warden.
character.guildmark.ilsa.topic.court.1: I've read everything ever written about them. It isn't much, and most of it was written by people who were running at the time.

character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p0: Don't reach for your sword. I'm not one of his.
character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p1: My name is Maren. The old ledgers call me the Last Warden. I tore the last page out of the Ledger of Names so the King could never read the names of those who broke him, and that page has kept me here ever since. Not alive. Not gone.
character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p2: You carry three shards of his crown. Every one you take weakens his court, but it wakes him a little more too. The shards can only be broken where he was crowned: the Hollow Throne.
character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p3: Find all seven. When you have them, I'll be waiting at the throne, and we'll finish what my Wardens started.
character.guildmark.maren.scene1.p0: You came. All seven. I can feel them from here.
character.guildmark.maren.scene1.p1: When you set them on the Shattering Stone, he'll rise to take them back. He'll call his knights and the echoes of every courtier you've killed, and when the crown starts to burn, so will the sky.
character.guildmark.maren.scene1.p2: I can't hold a sword anymore, but I can still draw a bow. Stand your ground and break his crown.
character.guildmark.maren.scene2.p0: It's done. The crown is dust, and the page is finally quiet.
character.guildmark.maren.scene2.p1: Your name is written on it now, under mine. Keep the roads, Warden. The road is the only home we keep.
character.guildmark.maren.topic.oath: Tell me the rest of the oath.
character.guildmark.maren.topic.oath.0: The road is the only home we keep. That's the line everyone remembers.
character.guildmark.maren.topic.oath.1: The rest goes: and when the road is dark, we are the light upon it, and when the light goes out, we are the road. We were very young when we wrote it. We meant every word.
main.guildmark.start: Wait, before you go! Take my compass. I fixed it so it points at the next shard instead of north. Six more are out there, each guarded by one of the King's old court. Find them before somebody worse does.
main.guildmark.new_compass: Lost it already? Here's another. I make them in batches for exactly this reason.
main.guildmark.letter1: Two shards! The Broodmother had it in her nest the whole time. My map says the next one lies in a barrow. Tobin went very quiet when I told him.
main.guildmark.letter2: So the court took my old master's tomb and dressed one of its own in his armour. You've laid him to rest twice over now. Thank you. And watch yourself: something followed you out of that barrow, and it wasn't a monster.
main.guildmark.letter3: The Herald was the court's voice. It sang the King's summons across the water, and now the bones near my chapel have finally stopped humming. Four shards. Be careful, they've started humming instead.
main.guildmark.letter4: The Crone kept the King's rites. Her echo was preparing a coronation. His. Five shards now. Whatever you do, don't put them together until Maren says so.
main.guildmark.letter5: The Frost Regent was a Warden once, the only one who knelt to the King. I've spat on his name for fifty years, and now you've ended him. Six. One left.
main.guildmark.letter6: SEVEN! That's all of them! My compass has gone mad, it's pointing somewhere I've never mapped. Maren's throne. Ilsa says go. Tobin says go armed. I say bring me back a sketch.
main.guildmark.throne_begin: Here he comes. Stay out of reach when he raises that sword!
main.guildmark.finale: It's over. Your name is on the last page now, under mine. Keep the roads, Warden.
main.guildmark.epilogue.wren: Ilsa felt it all the way from her chapel, and Tobin cried. Don't tell him I told you. Come visit! I want to draw the throne.
main.guildmark.epilogue.tobin: A Warden again, after all these years. My forge is yours whenever you need it, Warden.
main.guildmark.epilogue.ilsa: The bones are silent everywhere. For the first time in my life I can't hear the court at all. Thank you.
lore.guildmark.8.title: Lore: The Broodmother
lore.guildmark.8.page0: The Broodmother was the first beast to bow. The King gave her the darkest caves and a shard to guard, and she wrapped it in silk so thick that light itself got lost.
lore.guildmark.8.page1: Her brood still spins webs shaped like crowns. Cartographers who map them tend to stop making maps.
lore.guildmark.9.title: Lore: The Barrow Lord
lore.guildmark.9.page0: The Barrow Lord has no body of his own. He wears the armour of the dead, and he is always looking for better armour.
lore.guildmark.9.page1: He took a Warden's barrow for his seat and a Warden's plate for his skin. A squire named Tobin swore to put him in the ground. It took fifty years to find someone who could.
lore.guildmark.10.title: Lore: The Drowned Herald
lore.guildmark.10.page0: Every court needs a voice. The Herald sang the King's commands across rivers and seas, and anything drowned that heard it rose to obey.
lore.guildmark.10.page1: Fishermen still hear its song on still nights. The wise ones row home and don't look back.
lore.guildmark.11.title: Lore: The Hollow Crone
lore.guildmark.11.page0: The Crone keeps the King's rites: what must be burned, what must be buried, and what must be spoken at a coronation.
lore.guildmark.11.page1: Her book of rites ends with one unfinished line: 'And when the seven are one, the crown shall'
lore.guildmark.12.title: Lore: The Frost Regent
lore.guildmark.12.page0: The Frost Regent was a Warden once. When the others marched on the throne he knelt to it, and the King gave him a shard and a heart of ice to keep it cold.
lore.guildmark.12.page1: The Wardens struck his name from the Ledger. It is the only name ever struck out.
lore.guildmark.13.title: Lore: The Ash Warden
lore.guildmark.13.page0: The Ash Warden guards the deepest pit and the last shard. It was the King's champion, and it has never lost a duel.
lore.guildmark.13.page1: It burned the roads the Wardens built. Now, at last, someone is walking back along them.
lore.guildmark.last_page.title: The Last Page of the Ledger
lore.guildmark.last_page.page0: The torn last page of the Ledger of Names. The oldest names on it are Wardens: Aldric, Senna, Brannoch, Ivo, and at the very bottom, Maren.
lore.guildmark.last_page.page1: Below Maren's name, in ink that is still wet, a new name has been written: %s, Warden of the Road.
lore.guildmark.last_page.page2: The oath, in Maren's hand: 'We keep no crown and no village. We keep the roads between them, so no stranger walks alone. The road is the only home we keep.'

handbook.guildmark.page0:
The Adventurer's Handbook

Issued by the Guild to every new name on its rolls.

Keep it dry. Read it twice.
handbook.guildmark.page1:
QUEST BOARDS

Every village keeps a Quest Board near its bell. Each day its villagers pin notes that fit their trade. Notes nobody takes come down at dawn.

Use a note to read it, then take it as a Contract.
handbook.guildmark.page2:
CONTRACTS

Every job has a deadline. Finish the work, then use the contract on its own board to be paid in Guild Marks.

Press H to track your contracts.
handbook.guildmark.page3:
THE GUILDMASTER

Where a board stands, a villager may take up the Guildmaster's trade. They sell gear, supplies and Sealed Relic Caches for Guild Marks.
handbook.guildmark.page4:
THE LEDGER

Contracts and deeds earn guild XP. Bank it, then rest at a Wardfire and Grow Stronger: each level raises a stat and gives a skill tree point.

Skills grow as you use them. Press G for the Guild Ledger and its tree.
handbook.guildmark.page5:
RANKS

Adventurers are ranked F to S, and notes are rated the same way.

To climb, pass a rank trial from the receptionist at a Guild Hall. Higher ranks mean harder jobs, better pay and stranger places.
handbook.guildmark.page6:
STANDING

Villages remember you, from Stranger up to Hero.

Sneak and use a board to see its Advance: lamps, a guild hall, a Trade Road, walls and towers, built with your contracts.
handbook.guildmark.page7:
DANGER

Bandits wait along the Trade Roads.

Lair notes lead to monster dens with a boss inside. Villages you build up draw sieges at night. Hold the line, or lose what you built.
handbook.guildmark.page8:
RELICS

Bosses, champions and sieges drop Relics, from Common to Legendary, each with its own affixes.

Sealed Caches open into one. Read the lines carefully: a Kingslaying blade is worth keeping.
handbook.guildmark.page9:
YOUR OWN GUILD

At rank E, found a guild at a hall receptionist for 50 Marks.

Then sneak and use a villager in a village that trusts you to swear them in. Members follow you and fight beside you.
handbook.guildmark.page10:
FAMILIAR FACES

Some folk need an adventurer more than most. Wren the cartographer, Tobin the old soldier, Sister Ilsa and Pip the bard may find you once a village knows your name.

Hear them out.
handbook.guildmark.page11:
HOLDING VILLAGES

A guild leader the village honours can raise the guild's banner there, once it has a Guild Hall.

Held villages pay tribute when you visit and call your members to the bell in a siege.

rival.guildmark.gilded_stag.line3: A Gilded Stag never takes a shot it can't make. You might try it.

gui.guildmark.status.stamina.tip: Spent by attacks, rolls, blocks and sprinting in a fight. It refills once you hold back for a moment.
gui.guildmark.status.focus.tip: Spent on your weapon skill. It comes back slowly, and quicker with every blow you land.
gui.guildmark.status.armor.tip: Takes the edge off every blow.
gui.guildmark.status.toughness.tip: Keeps your armour working against the heaviest blows.
gui.guildmark.status.poise.tip: How much punishment you take before you stagger. It rises with armour and toughness, and heavy attacks add to it while they swing.
gui.guildmark.status.roll.tip: Up to %s armour your roll is quick and long. Above that it becomes a slow, short heavy roll. You wear %s.

gui.guildmark.status.attack.tip: What a plain swing with the weapon in hand deals, before your moves add to it.
gui.guildmark.status.speed.tip: Swings a second with the weapon in hand. Slower weapons hit harder.
gui.guildmark.status.style.straight_swor: Swords fight with the full set of moves: a three-blow combo, charged heavies, running and jumping attacks, guard counters, ripostes and the weapon skill.
gui.guildmark.status.style.greatsword.ti: Wide two-handed cleaves with a long reach, two to a combo. Slow, heavy on stance, and hard to knock out of a swing.
gui.guildmark.status.style.dagger.tip: Quick, close cuts, four to a combo, for little stamina. Ripostes and backstabs with a dagger hit far harder.
Fast, flowing cuts with wide arcs, the third a turning sweep. Light on stance, but hard to get out of the way of.
gui.guildmark.status.style.axe.tip: Chopping blows that wear a guard down faster than a sword's, the third a heavy overhead.
gui.guildmark.status.style.hammer.tip: The slowest blows and the hardest on stance, in both hands. The heavy and the jumping attack shake the ground all around.
gui.guildmark.status.style.spear.tip: Thrusts that reach far down a narrow line, the third a sweep to clear some room. Holding use still charges as a spear does.
gui.guildmark.status.style.plain.tip: What you hold keeps its ordinary swing. Take up a sword, axe, spear, mace or one of the guild's weapons for the full set of moves.
gui.guildmark.status.tempo.tip: How fast your moves play with the weapon in hand: one slower than others of its kind plays them slower. Finesse and the skill tree make you quicker.
weapon_skill.guildmark.straight_sword.ti: A full turn with the blade out, cutting everything around you.
weapon_skill.guildmark.greatsword.tip: A leaping overhead blow that splits the ground in a line ahead, and few guards hold against.
weapon_skill.guildmark.dagger.tip: A dash nothing can touch, ending in a stab.
weapon_skill.guildmark.curved_sword.tip: A dash forward through two sweeping cuts.
weapon_skill.guildmark.axe.tip: A jumping chop with all your weight behind it, breaking a guard wide open.
weapon_skill.guildmark.hammer.tip: The hammer brought down on the ground, throwing back everything around you.
weapon_skill.guildmark.spear.tip: A run with the spear levelled, through everything in the way.

handbook.guildmark.page12:
RIVAL GUILDS

The Iron Hounds, the Scarlet Ledger, the Gilded Stag and the Ashen Crows want villages too.

When one challenges your hold, meet their captain at the bell. Beat a captain to take their village.
handbook.guildmark.page13:
PARTIES

Adventure together: /party invite a friend.

Members close by share kills for contracts and a cut of each other's pay, and can't hurt each other.
handbook.guildmark.page14:
ROADS AND REVELS

Coaches run along finished Trade Roads: /coach.

On festival days, contracts pay more.

Milestones earn titles: /titles.
situation.guildmark.rebuild.0: The siege tore through %s. Half the east wall is splinters. Anything you can bring helps.
situation.guildmark.rebuild.1: We buried two last night. Now we rebuild %s, board by board.
situation.guildmark.rebuild.2: The monsters left %s in pieces. The houses won't fix themselves.
situation.guildmark.feast.0: %s held! We're throwing a feast for the defenders. Bring food!
situation.guildmark.feast.1: Nobody in %s has slept since the siege. A feast will fix that.
situation.guildmark.feast.2: The whole of %s is celebrating, but the larder is bare.
situation.guildmark.rival.0: %2$s take our coin and leave the monsters to us. Somebody has to do their job in %1$s.
situation.guildmark.rival.1: %2$s want payment before they lift a sword. %1$s needs a real guild.
situation.guildmark.rival.2: %2$s fly their banner over %1$s, but they're never here when the dead walk.
situation.guildmark.den.0: Something has made a den in the hills near %s. The children won't go out.
situation.guildmark.den.1: Tracks lead from %s's fields into the dark. Big ones.
situation.guildmark.den.2: The shepherds of %s say something nests out past the last fence.
situation.guildmark.land.desert.0: Husks wander in from the dunes every night and drink %s's well dry.
situation.guildmark.land.desert.1: The sand around %s moves at night. It shouldn't.
situation.guildmark.land.desert.2: Our caravan to %s lost two camels to the husks. No more.
situation.guildmark.land.snow.0: Strays stalk the snowfields around %s, and their arrows are cold as the wind.
situation.guildmark.land.snow.1: Nobody in %s hunts after dark any more. The strays see to that.
situation.guildmark.land.snow.2: Frozen archers on the ridge above %s. Please.
situation.guildmark.land.swamp.0: The bog around %s bubbles and something hops out of it.
situation.guildmark.land.swamp.1: A witch has been cursing the hens of %s. Probably. Either way, deal with it.
situation.guildmark.land.swamp.2: The swamp gives %s fish and frogs and far too much slime.
situation.guildmark.land.taiga.0: Raiders from the outpost watch %s from the treeline.
situation.guildmark.land.taiga.1: Pillagers took the woodcutters' axes, and then the woodcutters. %s wants them gone.
situation.guildmark.land.taiga.2: Crossbow bolts in the door of %s's chapel. A warning, they say.
situation.guildmark.land.savanna.0: Raiders ride across the grass to %s at dawn. Thin them out.
situation.guildmark.land.savanna.1: The acacias around %s hide more than shade. Pillagers.
situation.guildmark.land.savanna.2: Two traders from %s never came home. We know who took them.
situation.guildmark.land.jungle.0: Spiders the size of dogs in the canopy over %s.
situation.guildmark.land.jungle.1: Webs across every path out of %s. Cut them, and what made them.
situation.guildmark.land.jungle.2: The vines around %s crawl at night. Not the vines. The spiders.
situation.guildmark.land.plains.0: The dead walk the fields of %s every night now.
situation.guildmark.land.plains.1: Zombies at the doors of %s again. We've run out of planks to nail.
situation.guildmark.land.plains.2: Somebody please make the nights in %s quiet again.
quest.guildmark.story.armorer.hunt.zombi: New mail, never worn in a real fight. Go change that.
The dead keep scratching at my shutters. My sleep for your pay.
quest.guildmark.story.armorer.champion.s: Arrows bounce off its plate. Mine. It took a set off a dead guard.
Three lambs gone this week. I'd rather sell them than feed wolves.
quest.guildmark.story.cartographer.escor: My niece wants to see the world. Start her with the next village over.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.hunt.zombie: They were our neighbours once. Grant them peace.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.hunt.husk.0: Husks shamble in from the sand and the well tastes of dust after.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.hunt.husk.1: Dried-out dead in the fields. The sun should have finished them.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.hunt.phanto: Nobody has slept for days, and the phantoms grow bolder every night.
Something screams over the chapel at night. Shoot it down.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.champion.zo: It wears a crown of rust and the dead obey it.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.hunt.dro: The nets come up torn, and the drowned laugh from the water.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.hunt.gna: A pack of Gnashfins follows the boats out past the reef. They took my brother's oar, then his hand.
Something with a fin like a torn sail circles our nets by night. Thin out that pack.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.fetch.gn: Gnashfin fangs make the finest fish-hooks on this coast, and the strongest needles. Bring me some.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.fetch.gu: Gulls nest on the stacks out past the point. Their eggs fetch a good price, if you can stand the birds.
My wife swears by gull eggs for a winter cough. Mind the colony: they'll mob you for every one you take.
quest.guildmark.story.butcher.fetch.gull: Gull eggs, fresh from the rookery. Rich as butter and twice as dear. Fill me a basket.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.hunt.smu: Smugglers keep a den in a sea cave out on the isles. They cut our nets and sink whoever sees them. Bring down their hired axes.
Some nights a light shows out on the isles, and another answers it. Smugglers. Their axemen have killed two of ours.
quest.guildmark.story.fletcher.hunt.skel: Their arrows are better than mine. I want to see how they're fletched.
quest.guildmark.story.librarian.hunt.wit: She brews in the marsh and something in it is poisoning the bees.
Two hundred years old and the binding is held with hope. Carry it flat.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.fetch.whi: White wool for the bride's dress, and the wedding is soon.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.fetch.bla: Mourning cloaks for the miller's family. Black wool, please.
Black wool hides the dirt. The farmhands all want it.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.fetch.she: Snapped my last shears on a ram with a temper.
Shearing season, and only one pair of shears in the whole village.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.fetch.whe: The flock's half starved after a dry month. Wheat, please.
Winter fodder runs thin. Bring wheat for the sheep.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.hunt.wolf: I count the flock every dusk and every dusk it's one fewer.
quest.guildmark.story.toolsmith.fetch.ir: My forge eats iron faster than the mine gives it.
quest.guildmark.story.toolsmith.fetch.co: The forge went cold overnight and the coal shed is empty.
No coal, no fire, no tools. Simple as that.
quest.guildmark.story.toolsmith.fetch.st: Handles, handles, handles. Everyone breaks the handle.
I need sticks. Lots of sticks. Don't ask what for.
quest.guildmark.story.toolsmith.fetch.co: Copper is all the rage. Everyone wants a lightning rod now.
Copper for a new bell. Ours cracked in the cold.
quest.guildmark.story.toolsmith.fetch.di: A diamond pick for the mine boss. He pays well; so will I.
One diamond, and I'll make something worth a song.
A sword order for the guards, and no iron to make it.
Hot forge, sharp blades. I need coal for both.
The bellows are fine. The coal pile isn't.
Flint for arrowheads. The fletcher and I share a deal.
Flint strikes sparks and edges. I need plenty of both.
quest.guildmark.story.weaponsmith.hunt.v: A vindicator's axe is better steel than mine. Bring me a few to study.
quest.guildmark.story.weaponsmith.hunt.p: Pillagers keep raiding the caravans that bring my iron.
quest.guildmark.story.weaponsmith.hunt.s: I'm testing a new blade. Skeletons don't complain.
Bones keep rattling past my forge at night. Make them stop.
quest.guildmark.story.weaponsmith.champi: He's wearing one of my swords. Bring it back, with interest.
quest.guildmark.story.village.fetch.brea: Harvest feast tomorrow and the oven broke. Bread, please!
quest.guildmark.story.village.fetch.appl: Apples for the children's games at the fair.
quest.guildmark.story.village.fetch.torc: The nights are getting longer. Torches for the lanes.
Monsters avoid the light. We want a lot more of it.
